operator_cli_path.disposition: Intended trusted local operator capability; no untrusted message-to-command/write path established.
operator_cli_path.reviewSeverity: informational under this documented caller contract
operator_cli_path.basis: Developer-selected executable/output paths are explicit tool capabilities. execFile uses fixed argument arrays without a shell. Staging checks canonical nonsymlink parent, absent target, ignored repo artifact location and strict allowlisted source/asset paths; it uses exclusive destination writes. Formal report names are fixed or use closed internal labels.
operator_cli_path.smallestFix: No fake sanitizer or removal of legitimate operator-selected paths is justified by the title alone. Preserve existing containment and explicit trusted-operator contract. A future untrusted caller must receive a separate owned-output/executable capability; choosing an executable and checking its --version after invocation is not an authenticity proof.

path_lookup.disposition: Trusted local process environment assumption; no public input-to-PATH flow shown.
path_lookup.basis: Fixed openssl/git/anvil names rely on the developer/CI tool environment. A writable compromised PATH can select another tool; that is distinct from shell-argument injection.
path_lookup.smallestFix: Prefer an existing reviewed absolute executable resolver/pin at trusted composition when available; retain argument arrays and existing toolchain checks. Do not alter managed proxy, CA or TLS, or invent an unreviewed executable pin.

pre_import_assertion.disposition: Fail-closed sandbox/provenance preflight exists; structure recommendation only.
pre_import_assertion.basis: These assertions check isolation, budgets, hashes, signatures/key bindings and negative controls before any actual SDK import. Later actual node:test cases already exist. Moving just assertions into a hook while leaving imports at module scope would weaken isolation.
pre_import_assertion.smallestFix: If restructured, put the complete preflight AND subsequent dynamic import in an awaited node:test before hook or one awaited case; expose SDK state to later cases only after all checks pass. Preserve every pin/isolation/negative control. No SDK import/evaluation is executed in this triage.

string_sort.disposition: Current lexical order is valid for these string collections; explicit deterministic comparator recommended.
string_sort.basis: All ten collections are string keys, IDs, geohashes, module paths or asset paths. They are not numeric arrays. Canonical/provenance byte order must remain independent of locale/ICU.
string_sort.smallestFix: Use explicit (a,b)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0 string comparison consistently at paired sorts. Do not replace canonical string ordering with localeCompare or change payload/hash versions.

number_namespace.disposition: Namespace style aliases; no new validation or authority defect established.
number_namespace.basis: NaN intentionally represents unknown time; parseInt conversions retain existing fixed input/radix checks.
number_namespace.smallestFix: Use Number.NaN and Number.parseInt at the cited locations without changing unknown-time behavior, input bounds or radix.

promise_handler.disposition: An explicit asynchronous rejection handler already exists.
promise_handler.basis: Promise.resolve(call()).then(success,rejection) routes rejection to fixed UNAVAILABLE, while the synchronous try catches construction failure. The enclosing Promise executor is synchronous.
promise_handler.smallestFix: An explicit .then(success).catch(()=>refusal(UNAVAILABLE)) form may clarify handling while retaining construction catch, finish-once, timeout and drain. Never turn this into an async Promise executor.

bounded_regex.disposition: P3 bounded local performance-hardening candidate; no exploit or timing measurement.
bounded_regex.basis: Variable-length overlapping scans can revisit candidate starts. Formal source is capped at 1 MiB/file, 256 files, 8 MiB closure; docs are hash checked and capped at 64 KiB/file, 128 links, 240-character targets. Bounds do not establish linear CPU use.
bounded_regex.smallestFix: Use bounded single-pass extraction for the specific import/link grammar. Preserve supported Solidity mappings and source containment; preserve explicit malformed/oversized refusal, especially docs target>240 rather than silently ignoring a failed bounded regex. Root must admit source/focused parser edits separately; do not reset solver quotas or run SDK/probe work.

helper_assertion.disposition: Meaningful strict helper assertions exist; not an empty test.
helper_assertion.basis: The admission test calls val/fail helpers that assert successful and denied reentry results. Failure callbacks are intentional negative controls.
helper_assertion.smallestFix: Keep complete checks and redaction assertions. Inline one existing genuine assertion group if analyzer visibility is needed; do not add assert.ok(true) or delete a control.

standalone_browser.disposition: Real standalone native browser assertion journey exists; node:test classification issue.
standalone_browser.basis: The file asserts actual nested client/Worker/recovery behavior, scriptless portal downloads and byte-exact public/wiki assets, with finally cleanup.
standalone_browser.smallestFix: A named node:test case can wrap the existing asynchronous journey at the same maintained entry. Preserve exact assertions, network block, cleanup and reports; no placeholder test, deletion or native rerun in this task.
